title: Introduce RAG Lab Notebook quickstart: modular tool-chains and replayable sessions
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Added a new RAG Lab Notebook quickstart with modular tool-chain examples, replayable sessions, and a lightweight docsite plugin for embedded live snippets.
body:
Motivation: provide a compact, reproducible developer experience that demonstrates multi-tool RAG flows, session replayability for deterministic e2e tests, and an embeddable docsite plugin for live snippet playback. This quickstart is targeted at engineers evaluating tool-calling patterns and teams who want a local-first authoring loop with telemetry probes.
Checklist: [x] Draft quickstart content and walkthrough; [x] Sample agent + typed tool-bindings (TS); [x] Playback shim + Python proxy for webhook/tool simulation; [x] Docsite plugin that renders runnable snippets with a safe sandbox; [x] CI smoke workflow for e2e replayable session; [x] Telemetry probes and sample dashboard config.
Summary: This PR adds a new quickstart under quickstarts/lab-notebook that includes a step-by-step README, a minimal TypeScript example agent (sample-agent.ts) demonstrating two tool calls (search + code-exec), a lightweight playback proxy (playback-proxy.py) for simulating tool responses in CI/local runs, and a small docsite plugin (docs/plugins/lab-notebook-plugin.md + static assets) that can render and replay recorded sessions inside our docs site. The core idea is to give engineers a single-workspace developer loop: author prompts and tools, record a session, replay deterministically in CI, and iterate.
Commit summary: 1) initial scaffolding and README; 2) add sample-agent.ts and typed tool contract; 3) playback-proxy.py and tests for deterministic replay; 4) docsite plugin scaffolding and example embedded snippet; 5) CI workflow and smoke e2e; 6) telemetry probe defaults and dashboard sample.
Files changed (high-level): quickstarts/lab-notebook/README.md - walkthrough and architecture diagrams; quickstarts/lab-notebook/sample-agent.ts - TS example agent and typed tool contracts; quickstarts/lab-notebook/index.json - quickstarts registry entry; examples/lab-notebook/playback-proxy.py - lightweight local proxy to stub tool backends; docs/plugins/lab-notebook-plugin.md - plugin usage and embed API; website/static/lab-notebook-playback.js - minimal playback runtime; ci/smoke-lab-notebook.yml - GitHub Actions smoke tests; telemetry/probes/lab-notebook-probes.yaml - example probes; tests/lab-notebook/replay_test.py - deterministic session replay assertion; package.json updates - small dev deps for ts build and docsite plugin; Makefile - convenience targets.
Review conversation (high level): "Liam: This looks useful; can we scope the playback proxy to disallow external network egress by default?" "Aisha: Proxy now defaults to local-only and validates host headers; updated README and CI to use the local proxy." "Marta: Docsite plugin should sanitize user-submitted snippets to avoid leaking secrets." "Aisha: Added a sanitization step in the plugin and a config toggle in docs that disables run buttons in prod builds." "Chen: Tests flaked on macOS runner due to ephemeral port contention." "Aisha: Fixed by explicit port choice and retry backoff in replay_test.py; re-ran CI."
CI summary: GitHub Actions workflow runs: node: build+lint+typed-tests (pass), python: replay unit tests (pass), docsite: plugin build + static-check (pass), smoke: e2e replay smoke (pass). There were two flaky runs early in review (replay_test.py timing), flake fixed and CI green on rerun.
Merge notes: Squash-and-merge used. Merged on 2026-02-23 by Aisha Patel after approvals from Liam and Marta. Post-merge actions: quickstarts index updated, staging docs site built with the new plugin (deployed to staging); CI smoke workflow scheduled to run daily for the new quickstart.
How to use (short): 1) git clone && cd quickstarts/lab-notebook; 2) make dev (starts playback proxy + local dev agent); 3) open docs site locally to view the embedded session player; 4) run tests: poetry run pytest tests/lab-notebook/replay_test.py to validate replay determinism.
Notes for maintainers: Keep the playback proxy intentionally minimal and documented; do not add network forwarding by default. Telemetry probes are intentionally opt-in via quickstart config. This PR is intentionally scoped to examples + docs + a light plugin to avoid platform surface area changes.

notes_for_reviewers: Focus review on: tool-contract examples, deterministic replay approach, security of the plugin run buttons, and telemetry probe defaults. This PR is examples/docs-only and does not change production inference code.
testing_instructions: Run 'make dev' to start local playback proxy and ts watch; run 'poetry run pytest tests/lab-notebook/replay_test.py' for deterministic replay tests; open docs via yarn start in website/ to validate embedded session player.
